<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h1>Battery 2 · <span>%%PROFILE_NAME%%</span></h1>
    <div class="stats" id="stats"></div>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="Surface">
        <button type="button" data-f="all" aria-pressed="true">All</button>
        <button type="button" data-f="site" aria-pressed="false">Site</button>
        <button type="button" data-f="console" aria-pressed="false">Console</button>
      </div>
      <div class="seg" role="group" aria-label="View">
        <button type="button" data-v="side" aria-pressed="true">Side by side</button>
        <button type="button" data-v="overlay" aria-pressed="false">Overlay</button>
      </div>
      <label class="op" for="opacity">AI on top <input id="opacity" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50"></label>
      <label for="sort" class="id">Sort</label>
      <select id="sort"><option value="order">Page order</option><option value="low">Lowest score first</option><option value="high">Highest score first</option></select>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>
<main class="wrap" id="list"></main>

<script>
  const DATA = %%DATA%%
  const PHONE = '%%COLW%%' === '393'
  const list = document.getElementById('list')
  const cls = (s) => (s == null ? 's-na' : s >= 4 ? 's-good' : s >= 3 ? 's-mid' : 's-bad')
  const esc = (t) => String(t ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c])
  function card(p) {
    const el = document.createElement('section')
    el.className = 'page' + (PHONE ? ' phone' : '')
    el.id = p.id
    el.dataset.surface = p.surface
    const ai = p.ai
      ? `<img loading="lazy" src="${p.ai}" width="${p.aiW}" height="${p.aiH}" alt="AI rebuild of ${esc(p.title)}">`
      : '<div class="missing">No AI page was produced</div>'
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="head"><h2>${esc(p.title)}</h2><span class="id">${p.id}</span><span class="pill">${p.surface}</span>
      <span class="score ${cls(p.score)}" title="Fidelity 0 to 5 for this profile">${p.score == null ? '–' : p.score.toFixed(1)}</span></div>
      ${p.notes ? `<p class="notes">${esc(p.notes)}</p>` : ''}
      <div class="cols"><div class="col"><div class="lab">Reference</div><img loading="lazy" src="${p.ref}" width="${p.refW}" height="${p.refH}" alt="Reference ${esc(p.title)}"></div>
      <div class="col"><div class="lab">AI with WebKit</div>${ai}</div></div>
      <div class="stack"><img loading="lazy" src="${p.ref}" alt="">${p.ai ? `<img class="over" loading="lazy" src="${p.ai}" alt="">` : ''}</div>`
    return el
  }
  let order = DATA.slice()
  function render() {
    const s = document.getElementById('sort').value
    order = DATA.slice()
    if (s !== 'order') order.sort((a, b) => ((a.score ?? -1) - (b.score ?? -1)) * (s === 'low' ? 1 : -1))
    list.replaceChildren(...order.map(card))
    applyFilter()
    setOpacity()
  }
  let filter = 'all'
  function applyFilter() {
    for (const el of list.children) el.classList.toggle('hidden-by-filter', filter !== 'all' && el.dataset.surface !== filter)
    const shown = DATA.filter((p) => filter === 'all' || p.surface === filter)
    const mean = (a) => { const v = a.map((p) => p.score).filter((x) => x != null); return v.length ? (v.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / v.length).toFixed(2) : '–' }
    document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML =
      `<span><b>${shown.length}</b> pages</span><span>site mean <b>${mean(DATA.filter((p) => p.surface === 'site'))}</b></span><span>console mean <b>${mean(DATA.filter((p) => p.surface === 'console'))}</b></span>`
  }
  function setOpacity() {
    const v = document.getElementById('opacity').value / 100
    for (const i of list.querySelectorAll('.stack img.over')) i.style.opacity = v
  }
  for (const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-f]')) b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    filter = b.dataset.f
    for (const x of document.querySelectorAll('[data-f]')) x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(x === b))
    applyFilter()
  })
  for (const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-v]')) b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.body.classList.toggle('overlay', b.dataset.v === 'overlay')
    for (const x of document.querySelectorAll('[data-v]')) x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(x === b))
  })
  document.getElementById('opacity').addEventListener('input', setOpacity)
  document.getElementById('sort').addEventListener('change', render)
  render()
  if (location.hash) document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1))?.scrollIntoView()
</script>
